places.name: Nieuwe Kerk (New Church)
places.ai_summary: A historic church known for its stunning Gothic architecture and the tomb of William of Orange.

opening_hours.notes: Special events may affect opening hours.

places.place_tip: Climb the tower for panoramic views of Delft.

places.name: Royal Delft
places.ai_summary: A museum and factory showcasing the iconic blue and white Delft pottery, with live demonstrations and exhibits.
places.place_tip: Don’t miss the gift shop for authentic Delftware.

places.name: Oude Kerk (Old Church)
places.ai_summary: A historic church featuring a leaning tower and the burial site of notable Dutch figures like Johannes Vermeer.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special concerts and events.

places.place_tip: Explore the stained glass windows and historic graves.

places.name: Markt Square
places.ai_summary: The central square of Delft, surrounded by historic buildings, cafes, and shops. It's the heart of the city's social life.

opening_hours.notes: Lively market on Thursdays and Saturdays.

places.place_tip: Try the local delicacies at the market stalls.

places.name: Vermeer Centrum Delft
places.ai_summary: A museum dedicated to the life and work of Johannes Vermeer, located in the house where he was born.
places.place_tip: Visit the museum shop for exclusive Vermeer prints.

places.name: Eastern Gate (Oostpoort)
places.ai_summary: A well-preserved medieval gate that once served as the eastern entrance to the city, now a picturesque landmark.
places.place_tip: Take photos from the bridge for a great view of the gate.

places.name: Delft University of Technology Campus
places.ai_summary: The campus of one of the world's leading technical universities, known for its modern architecture and vibrant student life.

opening_hours.notes: Access to certain buildings may be restricted.

places.place_tip: Explore the Aula and the Science Centre.

places.name: Prinsenhof Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum located in a former royal palace, featuring exhibits on Delft's history and art, including works by Vermeer.
places.place_tip: Look for the bullet holes from the 1574 siege.

places.name: Beestenmarkt Square
places.ai_summary: A lively square in the city center, known for its historic buildings, restaurants, and the weekly market.
places.place_tip: Enjoy a meal at one of the terrace restaurants.

places.name: Delft City Hall
places.ai_summary: An impressive Renaissance building located on the Markt, housing the city’s administration and a small museum.

opening_hours.notes: Check for public access to the council chamber.

places.place_tip: Admire the ornate facade and the bell tower.

places.name: Botanical Garden TU Delft
places.ai_summary: A beautiful and diverse garden showcasing a wide variety of plants, located at the Technical University of Delft.
places.place_tip: Visit the rock garden and the tropical greenhouse.

places.name: Delft Canals
places.ai_summary: The picturesque canals of Delft, ideal for a scenic walk or a boat tour, lined with historic buildings and trees.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored by foot or bike.

places.place_tip: Take a canal tour for a unique view of the city.

places.name: Agnetapark Historic Area
places.ai_summary: A historic neighborhood in Delft, known for its well-preserved 19th-century architecture and charming streets.
places.place_tip: Enjoy a peaceful walk and admire the architecture.

places.name: Museum Paul Tétar van Elven
places.ai_summary: A small museum in Delft showcasing the collection of painter Paul Tétar van Elven, including Dutch and French masterpieces.
places.place_tip: Look for the painting 'The Girl with a Pearl Earring'.

places.name: Armamentarium Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum displaying a unique collection of arms and armor, located in a historic building in Delft.
places.place_tip: Don’t miss the medieval weapons collection.

places.name: Maria van Jesse Church
places.ai_summary: A Gothic Revival church in Delft, known for its beautiful stained glass windows and peaceful garden.
places.place_tip: Visit the crypt and the beautiful garden.

places.name: Kalverbos Park
places.ai_summary: A city park in Delft, offering walking paths, a playground, and a petting zoo, perfect for families.

opening_hours.notes: Petting zoo may have limited hours.

places.place_tip: Great spot for a picnic or a leisurely walk.

places.name: Phoenixstraat Street Art
places.ai_summary: A vibrant street in Delft known for its impressive street art and murals, reflecting the city’s creative spirit.
places.place_tip: Bring your camera to capture the amazing artwork.

places.name: Delft Blue Workshop
places.ai_summary: A workshop where you can learn about and create your own Delft Blue pottery, a famous Dutch craft.
places.place_tip: Create a unique souvenir to take home.

places.name: Bicycle Tour through Canals
places.ai_summary: A guided bicycle tour that takes you through the scenic canals of Delft, exploring the city’s history and architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Book in advance to secure a spot.

places.place_tip: Bring water and sunscreen on sunny days.
